summary: Phase 6 full-stack testing (backend + frontend) of SkillTrace AI on the public preview URL. Created /app/backend/tests/test_phase6_export_consent_wage.py (15 pytest cases) — all 15 PASS. Verified: (1) CONSENT AUDIT TRAIL — GET /api/trainees/{id}/consent-logs is auth-protected (403 w/o token), returns events sorted ascending with action in {granted,scope_updated,revoked}, timestamp, performed_by, scope[]; seed contains all three action types and trainees with multiple events (193 logs / 150 trainees). WRITE PATH verified end-to-end: PATCH consent with a CHANGED scope (given=true) -> action 'scope_updated' + new log row; given=false -> 'revoked' with empty scope; re-grant -> 'granted' and consent state restored. UI: /trainee/:id (reached by clicking the trainee name in the provider 'My Trainees' table) renders consent-audit-trail with consent-log-0..N, correct labels (Consent Granted / Scope Updated / Consent Revoked), formatted date, 'by <performed_by>', scope list, and 'all scopes withdrawn' for revocations; new API-written events appeared after reload (7 events shown for Arjun Patil). (2) WAGE PROGRESSION — GET /api/trainees/{id}/wage-progression auth-protected, points sorted by months, wage_value matches WAGE_VALUE map (<10k=8,10-15k=12.5,15-25k=20,25k+=30), non-decreasing for all clean trainees; UI renders a Recharts LineChart (1 line curve + 4 dots + 1mo/3mo/6mo/12mo ticks) for placed trainees and the exact empty state 'Not enough follow-up wage data to plot a trend.' for trainees with <2 points (88/150 have 0 points). (3) REPORT EXPORT — both endpoints 401/403 without token; admin CSV = 150 rows with the exact expected 12-column header; PDF is valid (starts with %PDF, application/pdf). FILTER RESPECT CONFIRMED in the real UI: filter-district-select='Nashik' -> KPI 55 -> export-csv-btn download has exactly 55 rows, all District=Nashik; filtered PDF also valid. Gender filter also verified (all rows Female). ROLE SCOPING confirmed: provider CSV = 33 rows == its own trainees-overview count (strict subset of admin's 150); district_admin CSV spans exactly one district. (4) Regression: provider enroll flow end-to-end works (modal -> submit -> toast 'enrolled' -> table 33->34 rows), admin dashboard KPIs + 6 charts render and react to filters, trainee journey/risk/employment cards render, 0 page errors, 0 error elements. Also ran existing suites: test_phase2_regression + test_phase4_ml_wiring + test_ml_routes + test_auth_lockout = 71 pass. Playbook checks: bcrypt hashes are $2b$12$ for all 4 seeded users; lockout after 5 fails returns 429 (per-email, never 500); seed clear() wipes users so re-seed is idempotent. NOTE: this app uses Bearer-token auth (localStorage), NOT httpOnly cookies, and CORSMiddleware sets allow_credentials=False with allow_origins from CORS_ORIGINS env — cookie/credentials playbook items do not apply. All QA data cleaned (QA_Phase6 trainee + enrollment/consent rows deleted, 6 QA consent probe logs removed, consent restored, login_attempts cleared; DB back to 150 trainees / 187 consent logs).

minor.issue: MEDIUM: no per-interval de-duplication. 7/150 seeded trainees have 2 enrollments and therefore 2 follow-up sets, so the endpoint returns 8 points with DUPLICATE interval_labels (e.g. 1_month,1_month,3_month,3_month,...). Consequence: the chart plots 8 dots with repeated X labels and the series can DECREASE (trainee 6a98b55faa2e4c14b9e9a089 -> 12_month=20 followed by 12_month=12.5), contradicting the 'rising wage' story. Fix: aggregate per interval_label (latest responded follow-up, or max) before returning.

Non-existent trainee id (valid ObjectId) returns 200 with an empty payload instead of 404 for super_admin/state roles (assert_trainee_access returns early when allowed is None and there is no existence check).
Response items include the raw Mongo `_id` (stringified) — app-wide ser() convention, harmless but leaks internal ids; consider mapping to `id` or projecting it out.

PDF is summary-only (~2.7 KB: totals + provider placement table) and does not include the per-trainee rows the CSV has. Valid and filter-aware, but if the PDF is meant to be 'PDF of the filtered dashboard' consider adding the sector/wage/confidence tables or a row count line so users know the scope.
Pre-existing data inconsistency: provider dashboard shows Certified=35 while My Trainees=33/34 — certified is counted over enrollments, not distinct trainees (same 2-enrollment trainees as above).

design_issues.screen: Trainee profile — Wage Progression / Trainee Journey
issues: For dual-enrollment trainees the journey timeline lists each interval twice ('Follow-up @ 1 Month' x2, '@ 3 Months' x2, ...) and the wage line chart shows 8 dots on 4 x-positions — visually confusing; dedupe or group by enrollment.

action_items: wage-progression: de-duplicate points per interval_label (keep the latest responded follow-up per interval) so dual-enrollment trainees get a clean, non-decreasing 4-point series
Optional: return 404 for a non-existent trainee on /consent-logs and /wage-progression (add an existence check before building the payload)
Optional: exclude/rename `_id` in consent-logs items; enrich the PDF with the per-trainee or sector tables; count distinct trainees (not enrollments) for the provider 'Certified' KPI
critical_code_review_comments: wage_progression() maps every responded follow-up straight to a point with no grouping by interval_label — any trainee with >1 enrollment yields duplicate/regressing points. Aggregate before sorting.

_export_rows() issues 3 sequential per-trainee queries (enrollment, employment, followup) — 450 round-trips for the 150-row export (~2-4s). Fine at demo scale; batch with $in/aggregation if the dataset grows.
export_pdf() imports reportlab inside the handler on every request; move imports to module scope so a missing dependency fails at startup, not at download time.
assert_trainee_access() returns early for unrestricted roles, so all /trainees/{id}/* sub-resources silently 200 on unknown ids.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (exports, filter-aware export, consent trail, wage chart, empty state, enroll regression)

seed_data_creation: Temporarily created 1 trainee 'QA_Phase6 Regression' via the provider enroll UI and 6 consent_logs rows on trainee 6a98b55faa2e4c14b9e99e3a via the PATCH consent test. All removed; consent state restored; login_attempts cleared. DB verified back to 150 trainees / 187 consent logs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login testids are login-email-input / login-password-input / login-submit-button (NOT login-email/login-submit). Provider trainee rows: click the first <td> of [data-testid=trainee-table-row-0] to open /trainee/:id. Wage chart assertions must be scoped to the CARD locator, not `card.querySelector('svg')` — the first svg inside the card is the lucide icon, so evaluate-based checks report 0 dots; use page.locator('[data-testid="wage-progression"] path.recharts-line-curve'). Blob downloads work with page.expect_download + d.path(). Useful ids: consent-rich trainee 6a98b55faa2e4c14b9e99e3a, 0-wage-point trainee 6a98b55faa2e4c14b9e99e42, duplicate-interval trainee 6a98b55faa2e4c14b9e9a124. Run pytest with `-n 0` for serial; pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope. FLAKY: tests/test_auth_lockout.py::TestLockoutNonExistentEmail::test_five_failures_then_429 fails on a second consecutive run because the throwaway email is still locked — clear db.login_attempts before re-running (not an app bug).
rca_of_the_issue: Duplicate wage points RCA: seed.py assigns some trainees two enrollments and _seed_followups emits a full 1/3/6/12-month set per enrollment. GET /wage-progression queries followups by trainee_id only and appends one point per responded follow-up, so two enrollments produce two points per interval label. Because each enrollment has its own independent starting wage bracket, the merged series can step down (12_month 20 -> 12_month 12.5). Fix at the API layer: group by interval_label and keep the latest (or max) wage per interval.
